get_param_list: generate all combinations of hyperparameter values from a parameter dictionary for grid search experiments
get_param_str: format a single hyperparameter key and value into a command line argument string
getFolderLocker: acquire a directory-based file lock by creating a lock folder with retry logic
releaseFolderLocker: release a directory-based file lock by removing the lock folder
getStopFolder: check if a stop signal folder exists to halt experiment execution
